title: The Most Bizarre Alleged Bank Heist Caught on Bodycam
description:
Bodycam footage shows New Mexico police arresting a “Clyde” who may have forgotten his “Bonnie” in January. Steven Gurule, 32, faces a laundry list of charges after allegedly crashing a pick-up truck through an Albuquerque bank. Gurule allegedly broke into a car at a nearby car dealership before hitting a man with a tire iron and taking off in his own pick-up truck toward the bank. Body camera footage shows Gurule insisting that officers, “Call the FBI.” He was charged with aggravated battery, burglary, and robbery, among other charges. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
